places.name: Upper Pines RV Dump Station
places.summary: RV wastewater disposal near the Upper Pines entrance. NPS lists year-round service with fresh water; Recreation.gov lists the dump station as free.
hours: Year-round · check posted hours and access

details.label: Pin location
details.text: Approximate community-mapped relocated station. The October 2024 map edit reports a locally verified move; the position was adjusted in September 2025. The exact drain and entrance remain unconfirmed.

details.label: Fresh water
details.text: NPS lists fresh water here. Use the outlet signed for potable filling; do not use a waste-rinsing hose to fill a drinking-water tank.

details.label: Access
details.text: Use by visitors without a campsite reservation is unconfirmed. Follow campground signs and ask staff before entering restricted areas.

places.notice: Follow signs to the relocated station. This pin is approximate; current operation is unverified.
places.sourceNote: Reviewed October 2, 2026. NPS guidance supplies season/water; Recreation.gov supplies the free-use listing. Position: © OpenStreetMap contributors, node 3424485565 v8 (September 18, 2025), ODbL. NPS GIS appears to retain the former riverside position.

places.name: Wawona RV Dump Station
places.summary: Summer-only RV wastewater disposal in Wawona, on Forest Drive east of the Wawona Store. NPS lists fresh water with its dump stations.
hours: Summer only · opening and closing dates unconfirmed

details.label: Pin location
details.text: NPS digitized point, with unknown accuracy. This is the dump station in Wawona, separate from the campground pin.

details.label: Before using
details.text: Confirm seasonal operation, hours, fees and use without a campsite reservation. Follow signs for potable water and waste-rinsing outlets.

places.notice: Summer-only service; do not assume it is operating in October. Current operation is unverified.
places.sourceNote: Reviewed October 2, 2026. NPS public GIS feature 22323, edited January 10, 2026; source date and positional accuracy unknown. Published season is summer only, not live availability.

sources.label: NPS · Wawona campground and dump-station directions

places.name: Tuolumne Meadows RV Dump Station
places.summary: RV dump-station location near Tuolumne Meadows. Closed until further notice for wastewater-treatment-plant work; do not plan on using it.
hours: Closed until further notice · closure began September 8, 2026

details.label: Closure
details.text: NPS reports an ongoing closure for wastewater-treatment-plant work. The normal season is summer only; reopening and water availability are unconfirmed.

details.label: Pin location
details.text: NPS digitized point, with unknown accuracy. This marker records the facility location, not an available service.

details.label: Road access
details.text: Tioga Road is seasonal. Verify road status before traveling to the high country.

places.notice: Closed until further notice. This marker does not indicate an operating dump station.
